title: Underlying limits and tensor-preserved colimits lift to internal modules
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a monoidal category ([def-sfb-monoidal-category]), let $A$ be a monoid object ([sk-def-sfb-ring-object]), and write $U_A:\Mod_A(\mathcal C)\to\mathcal C$ for the forgetful functor of [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Let $J$ be a small category (its objects and morphisms are sets in a fixed universe) and $K:J\to\Mod_A(\mathcal C)$ a diagram.

1. For every limit cone $(L,(p_j:L\to U_AK(j))_j)$ of $U_AK$, there is a unique $A$-module action on $L$ making every $p_j$ $A$-linear, and the resulting cone is limiting in $\Mod_A(\mathcal C)$. A limit cone means a compatible family through which every other compatible cone factors uniquely.
2. Suppose $A\otimes-$ preserves colimits indexed by $J$. For every colimit cocone $(Q,(i_j:U_AK(j)\to Q)_j)$ of $U_AK$ ([def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]), there is a unique $A$-module action on $Q$ making every $i_j$ $A$-linear, and the resulting cocone is colimiting in $\Mod_A(\mathcal C)$. Preservation here means carrying colimiting cocones to colimiting cocones.

Neither assertion requires a braiding, closedness, additivity, or commutativity of $A$. No existence of an underlying (co)limit is assumed except for the particular cone or cocone to be lifted.
